THIS MFA IS FILED U/S.173(1) OF MV ACT, AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED: 26.07.2018 PASSED ON MVC NO.86/2017 ON THE FILE OF THE III ADDITIONAL DISTRICT JUDGE AND MACT, HASSAN, AWARDING COMPENSATION OF RS.70,000/- WITH INTEREST AT 6 PER CENT P.A. FROM THE DATE OF PETITION TILL REALIZATION.

THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT
The statutory deposit has not been complied by the appellant, even after granting nine opportunities.
2. Therefore, appeal is dismissed for non-prosecution.
